verdict.rationale: Claude Code is documented as a terminal-native CLI. You install it with a curl script, run `claude` inside your project directory, and it edits files, runs commands and handles git from your terminal on macOS, Linux and Windows. A community user corroborates that it is implemented as a bash tool rather than an editor replacement, while another reported an unresponsive terminal on first try. missing for 10: evidence that model inference runs locally rather than via Anthropic's API, broader hands-on reliability corroboration beyond one positive and one negative anecdote.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run a coding agent locally from my terminal

citations.quote: Use it in your terminal, IDE, or tag @claude on Github.
reading issues, writing code, running tests, and submitting PRs—all from your terminal.
Available for macOS, Linux, and Windows.
I do like how this is implemented as a bash tool and not an editor replacement though.
